text:
maya: Quick heads-up — ran FP8 (AWQ) vs FP16 sweep on stella-7bx on the new open-qa suite. Aggregate exact-match is -3.4% on the golden set, but latency/cost improvements are solid. Need rollout story across hosted/dedicated/private.
kevin: can you paste the per-route breakdown? which prompts drive the drop?
maya: per-route: retrieval-qna -4.8%, summarization -1.1%, dialog-stats ~0.0%. Top offending prompts are short-fact-checks and multi-hop questions. agree_rate dropped and hallucination score increased on a few probes.
anna: odd that summarization is fine. maybe FP8 bias in small-token outputs. did you check KV cache alignment and tokenization differences?
maya: yep, aligned tokenization. KV-check shows slight numerical drift w/ AWQ for tokens > 512 in some attention heads.
sophie: thoughts on rollout: I suggest 3-phase: (1) shadow traffic + eval-only on hosted (2) limited canary on dedicated (3) gradual private rollout with per-customer opt-in. fallback rules: immediate fallback to fp16 when golden_accuracy delta > 2.0% or hallucination_regression > 1.0%.
juan: +1. also add a "safety fast-fail" for safety-sensitive routes (auth, code-gen, finance summaries) — instant fallback at 0.5% delta.
kevin: implementation plan: use shadowing to dedicated GPU pools first to avoid impacting hosted qps. we'll route 5% sampled requests to AWQ instance and evaluate in real-time against fp16 baseline. if metrics stable for 24h, ramp to 20% then 50%.
maya: sample config I tested:
```
rollout:
  mode: shadow
  sample_pct: 5
  compare_to: fp16-2024-11-02
  metrics: [golden_accuracy, agree_rate, hallucination_score, latency_p95]
  thresholds:
    golden_accuracy: -2.0
    hallucination_score: +1.0
    safety_routes: -0.5
```
kevin: add cost and latency gates too. we should auto-pause ramp if latency_p95 increases > 15% or cost_per_token decreases < -10% (we still want savings but not at quality loss).
nana: typo — "anna" not "nana" ;).
anna: will add a lightweight eval hook that computes a composite early-signal metric (0..1) combining golden_accuracy and hallucination_score so ops can make a single threshold decision.
maya: also saw one weird failure where AWQ produced a short-form answer that passed BLEU but failed human judgement. let's keep manual review for first 200 shadowed failures.
kevin: deploy-bot: kick off a shadow campaign for stella-7bx-awq on dedicated pool dev-quant-4g with the config above, sample 5% for 24h and log diffs to /var/logs/quant-shadow/stella7b-awq.log
deploy-bot: scheduled: stella-7bx-awq shadow run -> pool=dev-quant-4g sample=5% duration=24h compare=fp16-2024-11-02 logs=/var/logs/quant-shadow/stella7b-awq.log :white_check_mark:
juan: after 24h let's run the automated golden set re-eval and a small human review batch (100 items from failed vs baseline).
sophie: for private customers we should surface an "opt-in handshake" that shows delta per-customer and lets them enable/disable AWQ variant. UI copy should warn about the specific routes with regressions.
maya: agree. action items: 1) run shadow (kevin) 2) add composite early-signal metric to eval harness (anna) 3) queue human review for top 200 diffs (juan) 4) draft private opt-in UX (sophie). I'll post results in 24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:"
